title: Warm Saudi-Arabian Bread Fries
description: A delightful twist on traditional bread, these warm Saudi-Arabian bread fries are perfect as a snack or side dish for any meal.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt for best results

instructions: Combine flour, water, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl to form a sticky dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Form the dough into small ropes, about 4 inches long.
Heat about 2-3 inches of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few bread ropes to the pan and fry until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fries from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining dough ropes.
Serve the warm bread fries hot, sprinkled with salt and a squeeze of vinegar if desired.
